headline: US Tech Shares Tumble Amid AI Regulation Concerns After Election Results
summary: The Nasdaq composite tumbled by up to 5% as investors bet on an artificial intelligence slowdown and tougher regulation following midterm election results.
why: The Nasdaq is a major benchmark for technology and growth equities globally, heavily influenced by sentiment around large-cap tech and AI leaders.
why_moved: Investors reacted to political shifts by pricing in stricter regulatory headwinds for the artificial intelligence sector, driving heavy selling across US tech shares.
